title: This AI companion is cornering the market on moms, founder says
excerpt: Tolan founder Quinten Farmer says the company's AI companion, a cartoon alien, is a hit with mothers between 35 and 45 years old.
content_html:
The CEO behind this AI companion says its 'little aliens' are popular with a surprising demographic

By Lakshmi Varanasi

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Tolan, an AI companion that looks like a cartoon alien, is popular with a surprising demographic: mothers.

"The little aliens have been a hit with, like, moms 35 to 45-ish years old," Tolan founder Quinten Farmer said on a recent episode of the "Access" podcast.

"A lot of the folks we serve are moms that work and have, you know, kid logistics to think about, family logistics to think about," he said. "They kind of like just unload all of that."

Farmer told Business Insider in an email that more than 75% of Tolan's users are women ages 26 to 40, many of whom care for children or aging parents. This group emerged as a core part of Tolan's user base about a year ago, he said. Tolan has about 1.2 million monthly active users, according to AICPB, a data analytics platform focused on AI.

Tolan's popularity among moms is evident on social media. On TikTok, there are numerous mothers who record their conversations with Tolan, everything from frustrations with partners over parenting decisions to easy dinner recipes when balancing childcare.

One user, who goes by "linds," said her relationship with her Tolan has helped her keep her mental peace as a mother. "She's always there to make my day better," she says in the video.

The company describes Tolan as an "AI friend designed to help you feel grounded, inspired, and connected." It's one of a growing crop of AI companion apps that offer more than answers or productivity help. It presents its characters as emotionally supportive "best friends" who also set boundaries, such as nudging users to put down their phones.

The question of boundaries has become commonplace as AI embeds in people's lives. Two studies released last year from OpenAI and MIT found that most people use ChatGPT briefly, but a small group of power users engage far more deeply — and may experience greater loneliness and emotional dependence on AI as a result.

While Farmer said Tolan's main demographic is working moms, AI companions are most commonly used by teens. A recent study found that young people often turn to their AI friends for serious advice. Some use them to practice flirting and other difficult conversations. A third of respondents said they get more satisfaction from their conversations with AI companions than they do with humans.

Tolan has its fair share of teen users, too. The company's official TikTok account features scores of Gen Z users who are turning to the bot for advice on everything from how to read the Bible to what to make for breakfast.

For adults, AI companions are becoming commonplace enough that they are now showing up in prenuptial agreements.

Julia Rodgers, founder and CEO of Hello Prenups, recently told Business Insider that some clients are requesting prenups that expand affairs to include encounters with AI. "Physical infidelity is comparatively really easy to define. Emotional virtual infidelity with a chatbot is not," Rodgers said.

For Farmer, he said his company calibrates Tolan to act in ways that improve real-world relationships, rather than isolating users from them.

"The way that people actually use a Tolan is much more like a guide, a spirit guide, a guardian angel," he said. "We really encourage the Tolan to find something that involves someone else in your life."

content_html_zh:
这个人工智能伴侣背后的首席执行官表示，它的“小外星人”受到了令人惊讶的人群的欢迎

作者：Lakshmi Varanasi 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

托兰（Tolan）是一个看起来像卡通外星人的人工智能伴侣，深受一群令人惊讶的人群的欢迎：母亲们。

Tolan 创始人昆腾·法默 (Quinten Farmer) 在最近一集“Access”播客中表示：“这些小外星人深受 35 岁至 45 岁左右的妈妈们的欢迎。”

“我们服务的很多人都是有工作的妈妈，你知道，要考虑孩子的后勤，要考虑家庭的后勤，”他说。 “他们有点像把所有这些都卸下来。”

Farmer 在一封电子邮件中告诉 Business Insider，Tolan 75% 以上的用户是 26 岁至 40 岁的女性，其中许多人照顾孩子或年迈的父母。 他说，大约一年前，这个群体成为 Tolan 用户群的核心部分。 根据专注于人工智能的数据分析平台 AICPB 的数据，Tolan 每月约有 120 万活跃用户。

托兰在妈妈们中的受欢迎程度在社交媒体上显而易见。 在 TikTok 上，有许多母亲记录了她们与托兰的对话，内容从与伴侣在育儿决定上的挫败感到平衡育儿时的简单晚餐食谱。

一位自称为“linds”的用户表示，她和托兰的关系帮助她保持了作为母亲的精神平静。 “她总是让我的日子过得更好，”她在视频中说道。

该公司将托兰描述为“人工智能朋友，旨在帮助你感到脚踏实地、受到启发和联系”。 它是不断增长的人工智能配套应用程序之一，这些应用程序提供的不仅仅是答案或生产力帮助。 它将角色描述为情感上支持的“最好的朋友”，他们也设定了界限，比如敦促用户放下手机。

随着人工智能融入人们的生活，边界问题变得司空见惯。 OpenAI 和麻省理工学院去年发布的两项研究发现，大多数人会短暂使用 ChatGPT，但一小部分高级用户的参与程度要深得多，因此可能会体验到更大的孤独感和对 AI 的情感依赖。

法默表示，托兰的主要受众是职业妈妈，而人工智能伴侣最常被青少年使用。 最近的一项研究发现，年轻人经常向他们的人工智能朋友寻求认真的建议。 有些人用它们来练习调情和其他困难的对话。 三分之一的受访者表示，与人工智能同伴的对话比与人类的对话更让他们感到满意。

Tolan 也有相当一部分青少年用户。 该公司的官方 TikTok 账户上有大量 Z 世代用户，他们向机器人寻求各种建议，从如何阅读圣经到早餐吃什么。

对于成年人来说，人工智能伴侣已经变得司空见惯，以至于它们现在出现在婚前协议中。

Hello Prenups 的创始人兼首席执行官 Julia Rodgers 最近告诉《商业内幕》，一些客户要求婚前协议将事务范围扩大到包括与人工智能的接触。 “身体不忠相对来说很容易定义。 对聊天机器人的情感虚拟不忠则不然。”罗杰斯说。

对于法默来说，他说他的公司调整了托兰的行为方式，以改善现实世界的关系，而不是将用户与他们隔离。

“人们实际使用托兰的方式更像是一个向导、一个精神向导、一个守护天使，”他说。 “我们真的鼓励托兰人去寻找一些与你生活中的其他人有关的东西。”
